transcript.question: Is Cameron Coscia's aggressive, cheap waiver-wire approach actually building The Stinky Faggots into a contender, or is it just churn dressed up as strategy?

hotSeat.why: Nina Sharpe is favorite on them (+72), Curtis Vaughn is neutral on them (+9)

sides.mel-diaper: Nine waiver pickups for a combined 24 dollars spent means Cameron Coscia is stockpiling depth and finding value that the draft board missed — that's a GM building for the long haul.
sides.reggie-banks: A 5-3 record with a loss to Chodie mcgruber this week says the churn isn't translating into wins when it matters, and that's all that counts on the scoreboard.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Good evening. The Stinky Faggots lost a nine-point nail-biter to Chodie mcgruber, 123 to 116.9, and still sit 5-3 with the league's most active waiver wire — nine pickups and just twenty-four dollars spent. So: is Cameron Coscia building a roster the right way, or is he just treading water at .500? Mel, take it away.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: TWENTY-FOUR DOLLARS. NINE PICKUPS. Cam Skattebo went at pick ONE HUNDRED FORTY-SIX and he's the RB10 on the board with 113.8. Rico Dowdle put up 32.4 and 33.9 in back-to-back weeks. That's not churn, that's a GM with SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS still in his pocket in Week 8. I say The Stinky Faggots finish top four. TOP FOUR.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish the regular season in the top four of the standings

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Cute draft board, Mel. Here's the scoreboard: The Stinky Faggots scored 116.9 and LOST to Chodie mcgruber by 6.1. Five and three, fourth seed, 1,094.2 points — behind GLORY ASSHOLE, behind SAGGY NUTS, behind IM NOT GAY. Nine pickups and they still put up 105.4 in Week 7. I say The Stinky Faggots finish FIFTH or worse. Treading water.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish the regular season fifth or worse in the standings

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: SIX POINT ONE, Reggie. SIX POINT ONE! And the bench was 19.7 — that's a lineup rounding error, not a broken roster. You want the real receipt? Bijan Robinson at pick TWO. Josh Allen at TWENTY-TWO. A.J. Brown 28.1 in Week 7. And Cameron Coscia paid ZERO DOLLARS for Will Reichard and the 49ers. ZERO. Nina — grade the churn.

managerMentions.evidence: And Cameron Coscia paid ZERO DOLLARS for Will Reichard and the 49ers.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Grade: partly supported. The waiver log shows nine acquisitions, twenty-four dollars spent — that column is real, I checked it twice. But "churn equals top four" needs a finish, and I don't have one — eight games is not a sample, it's an anecdote with a decimal. The lineup gap Mel wants ignored was 6.1, correct, but that's this week, not a trend line.
factsCited: B6 - Stinky Faggots budget: $76 remaining, 9 acquisitions
M20 - Chodie mcgruber 123, Stinky Faggots 116.9, margin 6.1

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Thank you, Nina — anecdote with a decimal, I'm stealing that. Mel, you want new receipts? Week 8 waivers: Cameron Coscia bid ZERO on Kyle Monangai and got outbid by a two-dollar claim from Prolapsed Peehole, a 2-6 team. Free kicker, free defense, and 116.9 on the board. Week 7 was 105.4 in a loss to IR Squad. Depth that scores nothing is a hobby. Call Walt.

managerMentions.evidence: Week 8 waivers: Cameron Coscia bid ZERO on Kyle Monangai and got outbid by a two-dollar claim from Prolapsed Peehole, a 2-6 team.

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: The record only goes back to this season, so I'll say what's in front of me. The Stinky Faggots have nine dollars of moves and 24 spent, but they lost by 6.1 to a team playing free agents on defense and kicker. Depth is a garden — you don't get credit for the seeds, only what comes up in October. Right now what's come up is 5-3 and fourth place. I'd side with Reggie on the finish, though I won't pretend the process is worthless — it just hasn't paid the mortgage yet.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: A GARDEN, WALT?! Then look at what BLOOMED. Week 6: 185.4 points. ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY-FIVE POINT FOUR — Bijan 35.8, Dowdle 33.9, Skattebo 31.0. Skattebo was pick ONE HUNDRED FORTY-SIX and he's RB10. Reggie, you're grading a 6.1-point loss and ignoring a 45-point win. Dex — is the Monangai zero-dollar bid reported, or is Reggie's story opinion?

managerMentions.evidence: Skattebo was pick ONE HUNDRED FORTY-SIX and he's RB10.

turns.speaker: dex-alvarez
turns.text: REPORTED. It's in the transaction log: Prolapsed Peehole won Kyle Monangai for two dollars, outbidding Cameron Coscia's zero-dollar claim. That part's confirmed, filed Week 8. Everything Reggie built on top of that number — hobby, depth that scores nothing — that's his read, not the transaction.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Thank you, Dex — REPORTED. Mel, one 185.4 in Week 6 and then what? 105.4. 116.9. Two straight losses. And the two teams ahead of them in points, GLORY ASSHOLE at 1,107 and SAGGY NUTS at 1,096.4, didn't need nine pickups to get there. Week 9 they draw GLORY ASSHOLE. Nine dollars of kickers won't cover Saquon Barkley's 33.4.
factsCited: M14 Week 7 T8 105.4 loss to T3
M20 Week 8 T8 116.9 loss to T2

managerMentions.evidence: Nine dollars of kickers won't cover Saquon Barkley's 33.4.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Let's settle the seed math. Nina — where do the Stinky Faggots actually sit right now, points and rank, no projections?

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class, the row: The Stinky Faggots sit fourth seed, 5-3, 1,094.2 points for. That's behind GLORY ASSHOLE at 1,107 and SAGGY NUTS at 1,096.4 — by 12.8 and 2.2 respectively. No projections, just the standings sheet. Eight games. Hold that loosely.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: TWO POINT TWO POINTS, Reggie! That's the gap to SAGGY NUTS — Nina just read it. You're calling 2.2 a canyon?! Meanwhile Cameron Coscia has SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS and Team Rive has TEN. TEN! Sammy Rivero blew NINETY on Woody Marks, who scored 15.1 in Week 8. That's the churn that doesn't translate. Seventy-six dollars buys December.

managerMentions.evidence: Meanwhile Cameron Coscia has SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS and Team Rive has TEN.
Sammy Rivero blew NINETY on Woody Marks, who scored 15.1 in Week 8.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Seventy-six dollars buys NOTHING in December if you're home, Mel. And look at the Week 9 sheet: The Stinky Faggots project 129.7 — LOWEST of all ten teams on the board. GLORY ASSHOLE projects 140. Money in the pocket doesn't score. Josh Allen went 24.2, Waddle 20.9, Shakir 20.8 in Week 8 — three guys over twenty and they still LOST by 6.1.

managerMentions.evidence: Money in the pocket doesn't score.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: A PROJECTION, Reggie?! You spent this whole hour telling me the scoreboard is all that counts, and now you're quoting a NUMBER THAT HASN'T BEEN PLAYED! Here's a played one: Week 6, The Stinky Faggots hung 185.4 on Moisty Loins and won by FORTY-FIVE. Forty-five! And the roster still holds Kenneth Walker III, Chuba Hubbard, Jerry Jeudy, David Njoku. That's a bench that outguns half this league's STARTERS.
factsCited: M8 Week 6 T8 185.4 vs T10 140.4, margin 45
T8 roster: Kenneth Walker III, Chuba Hubbard, Jerry Jeudy, David Njoku

managerMentions.evidence: That's a bench that outguns half this league's STARTERS.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: A BENCH, Mel! You just made my case — Walker, Hubbard, Jeudy, Njoku all sat while the starters put 116.9 on the board and lost. That bench scored 19.7. Nineteen point seven! And Week 6's 185.4 came against Moisty Loins, who are 2-6. Beat somebody standing up. Two straight losses, 5-3. I'll wait.
factsCited: T8 roster: Kenneth Walker III, Chuba Hubbard, Jerry Jeudy, David Njoku

managerMentions.evidence: Walker, Hubbard, Jeudy, Njoku all sat while the starters put 116.9 on the board and lost.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: We're going in circles on Week 6. Walt, you're the swing vote here — settle it: does one blowout of a 2-6 team outweigh back-to-back losses at 105.4 and 116.9?

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: No, it doesn't. This league's record only goes back to this season, so I'm not pretending there's a deeper book to check. But a 45-point night against a 2-6 team is a warm afternoon, not a harvest; the two losses at 105.4 and 116.9 are what's actually growing in that garden right now. I side with Reggie on this one.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Grade: Mel's "top four" — not supported, no finish exists yet, eight games in. Reggie's "fifth or worse" — also not supported on current standings, since fourth place, 1,094.2, is the actual row right now. Both opening claims are forecasts the record hasn't reached. That's the segment.

verdict.reason: The Stinky Faggots' 105.4 and 116.9 in consecutive losses outweigh a single 185.4 blowout of a 2-6 team, which is the number Walt and the current 5-3 fourth-place standing actually back.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Before the season, Mel and Reggie had no picks on record with this desk — nothing to check them against. Let's leave that behind. Mel, Reggie — final jabs, one each.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: You want somebody standing up? Week 9 they draw GLORY ASSHOLE — a team that just spent SEVENTEEN DOLLARS on a tight end. Cameron Coscia has SEVENTY-SIX left and nine bodies in. TWO POINT TWO points out of third, Reggie. TWO POINT TWO! Top four. TOP FOUR. And I'm filing a formal complaint against anyone who quotes a projection to me again.

Fifth or worse, and if The Stinky Faggots finish top four I'll hand you the flowers myself. Scoreboard. You can take that to the bank.
